privacy_note: This public node registry must not store private endpoints, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, internal network details, sensitive infrastructure topology, or non-public operational payloads. Public node records should use minimized public labels and high-level operational metadata only.
empty_registry_interpretation: An empty nodes array means no public node records are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify infrastructure inactivity or security status by itself.

constraints.node_label: Public minimal node label only; must not expose internal hostnames, private IPs, secrets, or sensitive infrastructure topology

verification.rule: Public node entries must be treated as descriptive registry metadata unless independently verified by a canonical proof record.
verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, or inconsistent node registry state must not produce operational certainty.

nodes.description: HBCE primary public infrastructure node record for documentation and governance review.
nodes.note: This public node record is descriptive and does not expose private endpoints, internal topology, credentials, secrets, or privileged infrastructure access.
